# Overlays

<p class="cli-lead">Per-tenant or per-region values on top of an environment.</p>

An overlay overrides selected keys without changing the environment
itself, for example different endpoints per region. Pass `--overlay` to
`run`, `export`, `secrets ls` or `secrets get`. Overlays are created in
the web app and appear as extra columns in the secrets grid.

## Examples

```sh
clavis --overlay eu run npm start
clavis --overlay us-east export --format dotenv
clavis --overlay eu secrets ls --reveal
```
